name: Platinic-Voe
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by bioluminescent seas. Beyond massive canyon systems, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
Standing still, you feel the hot air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Debris from the escape pod debris field rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
There is money in medicinal compounds and titanium and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
